CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates maintained by hoody424.
- **MeshCentral**: self-hosted remote management (remote desktop, terminal, files), official image ghcr.io/ylianst/meshcentral. - **LibreNMS-Dispatcher**: the poller sidecar the official LibreNMS image needs, for an existing LibreNMS container (for example A75G's). - **ntopng**: network traffic analysis, official image ntop/ntopng, with an external Redis so settings survive updates. - **nightcrawler**: watches marketplaces and shops (eBay, Shopify, any web shop) for new and used products, with spec filters, price tracking, alerts and optional Claude AI. - **Yopass**: share passwords and secrets through one-time links that expire; encrypted in the browser, kept in RAM only, works under a sub-path behind a reverse proxy. - **FluxMQ** and **FluxMQ-Dashboard**: MQTT 3.1.1/5.0 and AMQP message broker in a single Go binary, official images ghcr.io/absmach/fluxmq, with a read-only web dashboard. - **PacketFence-VM**: installs the PacketFence ZEN appliance as a VM in the Unraid VM tab. - **OpenVPN Access Server**: official image openvpn/openvpn-as. - **psono**: self-hosted password manager server, psono/psono-server.
Each app links its support page. Template problems can also go to https://github.com/hoody424/unraid-templates/issues.
